deviations.item: Order of work and test runs
deviations.reason: The script was written after the pre-registration commit b32e31c. Quick runs (few calls, output in a temporary directory outside the repository, not evidence) were made before the full run. Their statistical checks failed or held at random because the run counts are small. They changed no prediction, tolerance or configuration.

deviations.item: Row I, entry for Skellam at 4 bits
deviations.reason: The pre-registration lists A2 Skellam at 4 and 5 bits with the sensitivity of D at 5 bits. Row D has no 4 bit run, so a 4 bit entry would pair a noise measured at one scale with a sensitivity of another. The script drops the 4 bit entry and keeps the 5 bit one at the mean and at the bound.

deviations.item: Row B check 4, location of the docstring sentence
deviations.reason: The pre-registration says the docstring of the class contains the sentence about the local noise standard deviation. The sentence may be in the docstring of `__init__` instead. The script searches both and records where it was found.

When a statistical check of a row fails, the row is run once more with the seed offset 5,000,000 added to the seed rule, which changes only the input vectors and the seed given to tf.random.set_seed. A mismatch is called found when the same check fails in both runs. The seed does not control the noise (row H), so the replication has fresh noise.

The first quick run used the default local C++ execution context. A call of process.next failed there with the gRPC error 'Cannot embed a federated value' for every configuration, while initialize ran. The test C++ execution context (tff.backends.test.set_sync_test_cpp_execution_context) runs the same call in under 0.1 s. All rows use the test context. Row V records the outcome of one call in the default context. This is a finding about the runtime and not a change to any prediction. The pre-registration says secure sum is a plain sum in the local runtime, which holds in the test context.

deviations.item: Row J cannot run a call
deviations.reason: A call of the process built by tff.learning.ddp_secure_aggregator(1.0, 20) fails under the test C++ execution context with a protobuf DecodeError raised in replace_secure_intrinsics_with_bodies, and under the default context with the same error as the factory. Construction and initialize run. By the rule of the brief, a configuration that cannot run is a finding. The row records both errors and its prediction is not tested. The direct factory with the settings of the wrapper was not isolated further.

deviations.item: Checks added beyond the pre-registered statements
deviations.reason: A recomputation of each pre-registered model number by the helper functions (checks named 'helper reproduces'), and the report of the largest norm and the share above C in row D. None replaces a pre-registered check.
